name: System X
goal: Weekly highlight selection, keyword generation, reflection and remixing, optional alternative remix generation, next-week interest specification, and archive browsing.
description: tool is an LLM-powered web application that periodically resurfaces users’ e-book highlights as three keywords. Users write reflections on these keywords, which the system synthesizes with the original highlights into new textual remixes. Actors: model = language model; tool = web application.

processes.name: Weekly highlight reflection and remix
processes.description: After the reader uploads their e-book highlights, tool randomly selects one each Monday, and model generates three keywords while keeping the original quote hidden. The reader writes a short reflection, which the model synthesizes with the original quote into a new remix, revealing the quote and its source.
processes.rawExpression:
(highlights_1: artifact record)*
-> [tool select]
-> (highlights_1: artifact record)* + (highlight_1: artifact record)
-> [model generate]~
-> (highlights_1: artifact record)* + (highlight_1: artifact record) + (keywords_1: artifact language)*
-> [human generate]
-> (highlights_1: artifact record)* + (highlight_1: artifact record) + (keywords_1: artifact language)* + (response_1: artifact language)
-> [model compose]~
-> (highlights_1: artifact record)* + (highlight_1: artifact record) + (keywords_1: artifact language)* + (response_1: artifact language) + (remix_1: artifact language)

processes.name: Generate an alternative remix
processes.description: After viewing a remix, the reader can click Try Again once to request an alternative. model synthesizes the same highlight and reflection into a second remix, allowing the reader to compare both versions.
processes.rawExpression:
(highlight_1: artifact record) + (response_1: artifact language) + (remix_1: artifact language)
-> [human specify]
-> (highlight_1: artifact record) + (response_1: artifact language) + (remix_1: artifact language) + (retry_1: instruction categorical)
-> [model compose]~
-> (highlight_1: artifact record) + (response_1: artifact language) + (remix_1: artifact language) + (alternative_remix_1: artifact language)

processes.name: Set next week's interest
processes.description: After a weekly interaction, the reader can optionally submit a word describing their current interest. tool randomly selects a highlight for the following week, and model generates three keywords that include the reader's chosen word.
processes.rawExpression:
(highlights_1: artifact record)* + (remix_1: artifact language)
-> [human specify]
-> (highlights_1: artifact record)* + (remix_1: artifact language) + (interest_1: instruction language)
-> [tool select]
-> (remix_1: artifact language) + (highlight_2: artifact record) + (interest_1: instruction language)
-> [model generate]~
-> (highlight_2: artifact record) + (interest_1: instruction language) + (keywords_2: artifact language)*

processes.name: Browse reflection archive
processes.description: When the reader opens the tool archive, they can filter the collection to highlights with remixes and select a highlight to revisit. tool displays its original text and associated metadata, including previously generated keywords, written responses, and remixes.
processes.rawExpression:
(highlights_1: artifact record)* + (remix_1: artifact language)
-> [human select]
-> (highlights_1: artifact record)* + (remix_1: artifact language) + (archive_filter_1: selection categorical)
-> [tool select]
-> (filtered_highlights_1: artifact record)* + (remix_1: artifact language)
-> [human select]
-> (archive_choice_1: selection record)
-> [tool translate]
-> (archive_view_1: artifact visual)

representations.highlights: passages the reader highlighted in their e-books, with book and author
representations.highlight: the highlight picked for this week
representations.keywords: three keywords that hint at the highlight without showing it
representations.response: the reader's short written reflection on the keywords
representations.remix: a new text that blends the reflection with the original highlight
representations.retry: the reader's request for another version
representations.alternative_remix: a second remix of the same highlight and reflection
representations.interest: a word for what the reader is interested in now
representations.archive_filter: the filter the reader sets in the archive
representations.filtered_highlights: the highlights that match the filter
representations.archive_view: that highlight with its keywords, reflections and remixes
